From your first idea
to your favourite place.

From initial concept to final execution, we work closely with you. Detailed layouts and renderings help you see the direction before the space takes shape.

Start a conversation ↗
01 We listen +

Your ideas, needs, and aspirations are our starting point. We work together to understand your personal style and how the space needs to function.

02 We visualise +

Layouts and detailed renderings bring clarity to the design. We explore the relationship between furniture, colours, materials, and light before moving ahead.

03 We bring it together +

From concept to completion, the studio considers each design element, with a focus on quality, functionality, and the finishing details.

Two perspectives.
One creative vision.

Meet Radhika and Kartik Vashisht.
A shared passion for turning the idea
of a dream space into something real.

DESIGN & CRAFT

Radhika Vashisht

A graduate in Interior Design from the Academy of Applied Arts, Delhi, Radhika brings an eye for craftsmanship, furnishings, and textiles. Her approach pairs polished, functional spaces with attention to detail and a love for local craftspeople.

IDEAS & COLLABORATION

Kartik Vashisht

With a background in Commerce and postgraduate study in Interior Designing, Kartik brings fresh ideas and an entrepreneurial outlook. Alongside an experienced creative team, he helps people shape the homes and offices they imagine.
